bandReport.notes: COMPLETE. 28 questions, Q36-Q63 contiguous, no gaps, no duplicates. Page map: p06=printed 13 (Q36-42), p07=15 (Q43-47), p08=17 (Q48-53), p09=19 (Q54-57), p10=21 (Q58-63). The scan carries English pages only, at odd printed numbers; the even printed pages are the Hindi translation and are not in the render (visible only as faint bleed-through). BAND EDGES: checked both neighbours. p05 (printed 11, previous band) ends with a complete question — its option (d) closes at the foot of the right column — so Q36 at the head of p06 is a fresh, complete question, not a continuation. p11 (next band) opens with Q64 (Utpala dynasty of Kashmir), fresh and complete, so Q63 is genuinely my last and nothing of mine spills overleaf: Q63's option (d) closes cleanly on p10. NO shared Directions/code block anywhere in this band — every question carries its own four options. OPTION-ORDER HAZARD: four questions print their code options in a non-monotonic order and were re-verified by 6-9x crop rather than read once — Q41 is (a) 1 only / (b) 1 and 3 / (c) 1 and 2 / (d) 2 and 3, and Q56 is (a) 1 only / (b) 2 only / (c) 2 and 3 / (d) 1 and 2. Both are as printed. Q50 is the band's only Match List; its code grid (a) 2 1 4 3 / (b) 2 4 1 3 / (c) 3 4 1 2 / (d) 3 1 4 2 was crop-verified at 7x. TRANSCRIBED-AS-PRINTED, not defects but worth knowing downstream: Q46 option (d) reads 'Ownership and transfer of natural resources' (Article 371G's actual text is 'land' — confirmed at 6x, this is the page's wording, presumably the intended wrong option); Q56 statement 1 names 'Alexander Burns' and the site 'Sohagighat' (confirmed at 9x; the discovery at Sohagighat is generally credited to A. C. L. Carlleyle, so the name looks like a deliberate or inherited error in the statement — left exactly as printed). No page defects, no missing options, no truncated stems anywhere in the band. Two catalog gaps flagged on the questions themselves (Maratha/Shivaji, prehistoric rock art).
